Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. return: 1 if Alice wins under optimal play,-1 if Bob wins,0 for a tie.

numeric: Combined-value differences and left-associated comparator intermediates have magnitude at most2000000000; score difference magnitude is at most n*1000000000. complexity: O(n log(n+1)+1) time/O(n+1) auxiliary index/sort space. Decreasing total value captures both own gain and denial of opponent value. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
